character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every scene: dark moss-brown hair tied back with a simple cord, bright fern-green eyes, with a clearly recognizable face and stable adult proportions. They are a forest ranger who discovers a hidden waterfall beyond an old trail. Signature clothing: a deep green field jacket, weathered canvas pack, rolled sleeves, and trail boots. Defining personal object: a carved wooden trail marker shaped like a leaf. Keep the same facial structure, hairstyle, hair and eye colors, body proportions, clothing silhouette, and personal object throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Use one fixed protagonist identity throughout this theme's entire music video.
Preserve the same recognizable face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, key materials, colors, and defining personal object unchanged.
Do not replace the protagonist or add another lead unless the lyrics explicitly call for one.
